tokens.name: kaki
tokens.usage: Brand persimmon, theme-invariant. The mark's lit half, the cover, marketing. In product UI use `accent`, which deepens on light grounds.

tokens.name: kaki-deep
tokens.usage: Brand persimmon in shade, theme-invariant. The mark's shaded half; never used for text.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: App background (sumi ink at night, washi paper by day). Behind library grids and lists.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, dialogs, list groups; Android top and bottom bars and sheets. On iOS, bars and sheets are Liquid Glass instead.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Inputs, search fields, chips at rest, segmented-control track, grouped list sections on iOS.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Pressed / hovered rows and chips. Never a text ground for `ink-faint`.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows. Decorative only; not a control boundary.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control outlines (outlined button, unchecked switch track border, text field). Holds 3:1 on canvas and surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on canvas, surface, surface-raised and surface-hover.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: subtitles, metadata, chapter dates. On every surface token.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: placeholders, counts, read chapters. On canvas, surface and surface-raised only (not surface-hover).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Interactive accent: primary buttons, selected chips, active tab, progress, links, unread badges. Text in accent holds 4.5:1 on canvas, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover / pressed state of an `accent` fill.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Selected-chip and selected-row fill; `ink` text sits on it.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an `accent` fill (7.4:1 dark, 5.6:1 light).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px keyboard / D-pad / switch-access focus ring, offset 2px. 3:1+ on every surface.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Read / up to date / installed. Always paired with a glyph or word.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Update available, source outdated. Always paired with a glyph or word.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions and errors (delete, failed download). A rose red kept clear of the persimmon accent. Pair with a glyph or word.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Tracker sync, informational banners. Pair with a glyph or word.

tokens.name: glass-fill
tokens.usage: iOS only. Web/preview stand-in for SwiftUI `.glassEffect(.regular)`: the tint the system lays over blurred content. In Swift, never paint it; use the material. `ink` labels on it.

tokens.name: glass-rim
tokens.usage: iOS only. Preview stand-in for the specular edge of Liquid Glass (0.5px inner stroke plus a 1px top highlight).

tokens.name: glass-fallback
tokens.usage: iOS only. Opaque ground that glass surfaces fall back to when Reduce Transparency is on (the system does this for `.glassEffect`; custom drawing must match). `ink` holds 13:1 on it.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind Android dialogs and sheets. iOS alerts and sheets dim with the system's own scrim.

tokens.name: cover-scrim
tokens.usage: Bottom wash under titles laid over cover art, theme-invariant (art is never themed). Paper text on it.

tokens.name: reader-black
tokens.usage: Reader background: true black (OLED). Default reader ground.

tokens.name: reader-paper
tokens.usage: Reader background: white paper.

tokens.name: reader-sepia
tokens.usage: Reader background: sepia. Reader chrome on it uses `reader-sepia-ink`.

tokens.name: reader-sepia-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `reader-sepia` (10:1).

tokens.name: cover-rust
tokens.usage: Fallback cover ground #1 (no art). Picked by hashing the manga id; paper text on it.

tokens.name: cover-indigo
tokens.usage: Fallback cover ground #2.

tokens.name: cover-moss
tokens.usage: Fallback cover ground #3.

tokens.name: cover-plum
tokens.usage: Fallback cover ground #4.

tokens.name: cover-ochre
tokens.usage: Fallback cover ground #5.

tokens.name: cover-teal
tokens.usage: Fallback cover ground #6.

families.text: system-ui, -apple-system, "SF Pro Text", Roboto, "Segoe UI", sans-serif

styles.name: hero
styles.usage: Series title on the manga detail hero; the onboarding headline. One per screen.

styles.name: title-xl
styles.usage: Large screen titles (Library, Browse, History, More) when the bar is expanded.

styles.name: title-l
styles.usage: Dialog titles, empty-state headlines, section heroes.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Collapsed top-bar titles, list-row titles that lead a group, card titles.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.usage: Synopsis and long-form text on the detail screen.
styles.sample: A elf mage revisits the places she travelled with her party.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default UI text: list-row titles, settings, menu items.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Metadata lines: chapter date, source name, file size.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Section headers above grouped lists; set in uppercase.

styles.name: tile-title
styles.usage: Series title on a cover tile, two lines max, over `cover-scrim`.

styles.name: numeric
styles.usage: Counts, progress and page numbers (mono for steady width).

tokens.name: space-0-5
tokens.usage: Hairline nudges: badge inset, icon optical offsets.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside chips; stacked caption lines.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Cover-grid gap on phones; gap between chips; button icon gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row vertical padding; gap between cover and its text in list rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen gutter on phones; card padding; list-row horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Screen gutter on iOS large-title screens; dialog padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sections; screen gutter on tablets (cover grid gap 12px there).

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Hero padding; space above an empty-state illustration.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Empty-state vertical breathing room.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Top inset of onboarding and full-screen empty states.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Cover thumbnails at 40px and below (chapter rows, search suggestions).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Cover art in grids and the hero; Android filter chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Text fields; cards nested inside lists.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, menus, Android dialogs; grouped list sections on iOS (with continuous corners).

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Android bottom sheets (top corners) and dialogs (M3). iOS sheets and alerts are concentric with the device corners (`ConcentricRectangle`); 28 stands in for them in previews.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Buttons on both platforms, badges, switches; every iOS glass control (capsules: tab bar, toolbar groups, search field).

tokens.name: tap-android
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target on Android (Material).

tokens.name: tap-ios
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target on iOS (HIG).

tokens.name: bar-android
tokens.usage: Android top app bar (small) and navigation bar content height (80 with labels).

tokens.name: bar-ios
tokens.usage: iOS toolbar controls: 44pt glass circles and capsules. The floating tab bar is 62pt tall, inset 20pt from the screen edges.

tokens.name: cover-ratio
tokens.usage: Cover aspect (width / height, ~ 5:7). Every cover surface crops to it.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Standard icon size: Material Symbols at opsz 24 on Android; SF Symbols at `.body` with `.imageScale(.large)` (about 22pt) on iOS.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons inside chips, list-row trailing glyphs, progress ring.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Android menus and snackbars.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets and dialogs.

tokens.name: shadow-cover
tokens.usage: Cover art on the detail hero only. Grid covers stay flat.

tokens.name: shadow-glass
tokens.usage: iOS only. Preview stand-in for the soft lift under floating glass (tab bar, toolbar capsules, glass buttons). The system draws it in SwiftUI.

material.note: Liquid Glass stand-ins for the web previews. In SwiftUI the material is the system's: `.glassEffect()`, `.buttonStyle(.glass)`, `.glassProminent`.

tokens.name: glass-blur
tokens.usage: Backdrop blur radius used to approximate `.regular` glass in previews.

tokens.name: glass-saturate
tokens.usage: Backdrop saturation boost used with `glass-blur`. It keeps cover colors alive under the glass, as the real material does.
